name: clean-untrusted-v1
description: clean_untrusted(text, limit=2000): text from outside (relay messages, webhooks) before it goes into ticket history or an agent prompt. NFC; remove <!-- ... --> comments; drop control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters except newline and tab, tag characters U+E0000-E007F, variation selectors U+FE00-FE0F, U+2800, U+034F, U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FEFF; cut to limit. Visible text is never rewritten. The relay's description rule (relay-api.md PATCH /v1/me) already rejects what this strips, so cleaned workspace descriptions are unchanged.
